name: Amal Chicken And Preserved Lemon Tajine
ingredients:
1.5 tsp ginger powder
1/2 tsp of black pepper
1.5 tsp turmeric
4 garlic cloves minced
1 tbsp of finely chopped coriander
1 tbsp of finely chopped flat leaf parsley
1 pinch saffron
1/2 tsp of ras el hanut
1/4 preserved lemon pulp
juice from 1/2 lemon
1l of water
1 small onion finely chopped
2 chicken breast and legs
2 tbsp of olive oil
2 tbsp of vegetable oil
1 handful of olives
¼ preserved lemon peel thinly sliced
directions:
Small Bowl
    + Finely chop ONION

Medium Bowl - Spices + CHICKEN
    + CHICKEN
    + GINGER
    + TURMERIC
    + Minced GARLIC
    + Chopped CORIANDER
    + Chopped PARSLEY
    + SAFFRON
    + RES EL HANUT
    + PRESERVED LEMON PULP
    + LEMON JUICE

Large Pot
    + ONIONS on bottom
    + SPICES + CHICKEN on top
    + 1/2 Cup of WATER
    + Cook on low heat for 1 hour
    + After onions have browned pour :-
        + OLIVE OIL
        + VEGETABLE OIL
notes:
Original Recipe

1. Combine all spices in mixing bowl
2. Place chicken into mixture and coat well
3. Spread evenly onions in tajine
4. Place chicken on top of onions (maybe add 1/2 cup of water)
5. Pour rest of spice mixture over chicken
6. Cover tajine and place on low heat for 1 hour (2.5 -> 3 with large pot and glass lid)
7. After onions have browned pour oils
8. After 10 minute pour water up to lid
9. Check periodically to add more water to the lid
10. 10 minutes before finishing cooking place olives and lemon peel in top of chicken
